records.source: Could you check his lungs? He's been wheezing lately.
records.translation: Maaari mo bang suriin ang mga baga niya? Madalas siyang humuhuni sa paghinga nitong mga nakaraan.

records.source: This place is full of memories for me. Thank you so much for restoring it.$h
records.translation: Punô ng mga alaala para sa akin ang lugar na ito. Maraming salamat sa pagpapanumbalik nito.$h

records.source: This is one of the newer traditions in Pelican Town... but we've taken to it rather quickly. Haven't we, George?
records.translation: Isa ito sa mga bagong tradisyon sa Bayan ng Pelican... pero mabilis namin itong nagustuhan. Hindi ba, George?

records.source: Hmmpph... The wife's making me go to the clinic today.
records.translation: Hmph... Pinapapunta ako ng asawa ko sa klinika ngayon.

records.source: *grumble*... Good for nothing doctors... *grumble*
records.translation: *bulung-bulong*... Mga doktor na walang silbi... *bulung-bulong*

records.source: Well how much longer do I have, Doc?
records.translation: Aba, gaano pa ba katagal ang buhay ko, Dok?

records.source: I've never been religious but hey... I'm old.
records.translation: Hindi ako kailanman naging relihiyoso, pero... matanda na ako.

records.source: Hehehe... I skipped church to come here! I hope Yoba isn't too angry with me.$h
records.translation: Hehehe... Lumiban ako sa simbahan para pumunta rito! Sana hindi masyadong galit sa akin si Yoba.$h

records.source: I'm just here for the free coffee.
records.translation: Narito lang ako para sa libreng kape.

records.source: I'm getting some supplies for the saloon. Pierre's got the good stuff.$h
records.translation: Bumibili ako ng ilang panustos para sa saloon. Magaganda ang paninda ni Pierre.$h

records.source: Hey @. Sorry... the bar's closed until the game's over.
records.translation: Uy, @. Paumanhin... sarado ang bar hanggang matapos ang laro.

records.source: Seeing the doctor makes me nervous... What if I only have a few years left? I'm not at peace with the world yet!
records.translation: Kinakabahan ako kapag nagpapatingin sa doktor... Paano kung ilang taon na lang ang natitira sa akin? Hindi pa payapa ang loob ko sa mundo!

records.source: It's my liver, isn't it Doctor? I can see it on your face. *Sigh*... I really need to cut back on that sweet, delicious Stardew Valley wine.$s
records.translation: Atay ko iyon, hindi ba, Doktor? Nakikita ko sa mukha mo. *Buntong-hininga*... Kailangan ko talagang bawasan ang matamis at masarap na alak ng Stardew Valley.$s

records.source: Hi, honey! I'm mostly just here to visit Emily.
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal! Narito lang ako pangunahin upang dalawin si Emily.

records.source: The weather's too horrible to get out of bed.
records.translation: Napakasama ng panahon para bumangon sa kama.

records.source: It's too cold to get out of bed.
records.translation: Napakalamig para bumangon sa kama.

records.source: It's too cold to get out of bed.
records.translation: Napakalamig para bumangon sa kama.

records.source: The cold air isn't so bad if you bundle up!$h
records.translation: Hindi naman gaanong masama ang malamig na hangin kung makapal ang suot mo!$h

records.source: It's nothing serious... I'm just here for my annual check-up.
records.translation: Hindi naman ito seryoso... Narito lang ako para sa taunang pagsusuri.

records.source: Well... my nose has been a little runny, Doctor. But otherwise I'm doing fine!
records.translation: Aba... Medyo sinisipon ako, Doktor. Pero ayos naman ako bukod doon!

records.source: This stuff can definitely be incorporated into a healthy diet.
records.translation: Tiyak na maisasama ito sa isang masustansiyang diyeta.

records.source: I'm just putting away these groceries.
records.translation: Inaayos ko lang ang mga pinamili.

records.source: I'm just putting away these groceries.
records.translation: Inaayos ko lang ang mga pinamili.

records.source: Hi Honey. What are you doing at the clinic?#$e#Ah, you just came to see me. That's nice.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal. Ano ang ginagawa mo sa klinika?#$e#Ah, dumalaw ka lang sa akin. Ang saya naman.$h

records.source: Hi! I'm just shopping for some essentials, so I can continue to cook healthy meals for us.
records.translation: Kumusta! Namimili lang ako ng ilang pangunahing kailangan para patuloy akong makapagluto ng masustansiyang pagkain para sa atin.

records.source: The sound of running water is relaxing for me.
records.translation: Nakakarelaks para sa akin ang tunog ng dumadaloy na tubig.

records.source: Winter can be a dreary season, but events like this make it a little brighter!
records.translation: Maaaring malungkot ang taglamig, pero pinasisigla ito nang kaunti ng mga ganitong kaganapan!

records.source: 1... 2... 3... 4... Oh no! I messed up again.
records.translation: 1... 2... 3... 4... Naku! Nagkamali na naman ako.

records.source: 1... 2... 3... 4... Here comes a wave! *giggle*$h
records.translation: 1... 2... 3... 4... Parating ang alon! *hagikgik*$h

records.source: 1... 2... 3... 4... Oh no! I messed up again.
records.translation: 1... 2... 3... 4... Naku! Nagkamali na naman ako.

records.source: I wish I was old enough to see the mermaid show...$s
records.translation: Sana sapat na ang edad ko para mapanood ang palabas ng sirena...$s

records.source: I have to visit the doctor today, but I'm not afraid!
records.translation: Kailangan kong magpatingin sa doktor ngayon, pero hindi ako natatakot!

records.source: Can you show me how this tool works, Doctor Harvey?
records.translation: Maipapakita mo ba sa akin kung paano gumagana ang kasangkapang ito, Doktor Harvey?

records.source: Ohhh... My arms feel like gelatin... $s
records.translation: Ohhh... Parang gulaman ang mga braso ko... $s

records.source: Shhh... he's asleep.
records.translation: Shhh... natutulog siya.

records.source: Vincent hates going to the doctor more than anything, but he'll just have to deal with it.
records.translation: Higit sa lahat, ayaw ni Vincent na magpatingin sa doktor, pero kailangan niya itong tiisin.

records.source: Be brave, Vincent. Think of your father.
records.translation: Magpakatapang ka, Vincent. Isipin mo ang tatay mo.

records.source: Doctor Harvey? I'm worried about Vincent's height. Isn't he a little short for his age?
records.translation: Doktor Harvey? Nag-aalala ako sa tangkad ni Vincent. Hindi ba medyo pandak siya para sa edad niya?

records.source: Vincent was very brave at the doctor's today. I'm proud of him.
records.translation: Napakatapang ni Vincent sa pagpapatingin sa doktor ngayon. Ipinagmamalaki ko siya.

records.source: Hey! You can't just barge into a private appointment!$u
records.translation: Uy! Hindi ka maaaring basta sumugod sa pribadong pagpapatingin!$u

records.source: It must be so thrilling to travel the world like they do... *sigh*...
records.translation: Tiyak na kapana-panabik ang maglakbay sa mundo gaya nila... *buntong-hininga*...

records.source: Hello, @. I'm just enjoying the fresh air for a while. I was starting to get cabin fever at home.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Nagpapahangin lang ako sandali. Nababagot na ako sa loob ng bahay.

records.source: Hi. Here to see the doctor?
records.translation: Kumusta. Magpapatingin ka sa doktor?

records.source: Do I look healthy, Doctor Harvey?
records.translation: Mukha ba akong malusog, Doktor Harvey?

records.source: Hmmm... a Lupini original? Not bad...
records.translation: Hmmm... isang orihinal na gawa ni Lupini? Hindi masama...

records.source: Oh, are you hungry? I already finished all the food...$u
records.translation: Ah, gutom ka ba? Naubos ko na ang lahat ng pagkain...$u

records.source: Can't talk right now, @. I have to really focus...
records.translation: Hindi ako puwedeng makipag-usap ngayon, @. Kailangan kong talagang magpokus...

records.source: We don't mind the rain too much, but it's nice to dry off in here sometimes.
records.translation: Hindi naman kami gaanong naaabala sa ulan, pero masarap ding magpatuyo rito paminsan-minsan.

records.source: It's going to take a while, but I'm trying to get through all the books in the library.#$b#I have a lot of catching up to do...$s
records.translation: Matatagalan ito, pero sinusubukan kong basahin ang lahat ng aklat sa aklatan.#$b#Marami akong kailangang habulin...$s

records.source: I just like looking at the lights.#$b#It reminds me of something, long, long ago...$s
records.translation: Gusto ko lang pagmasdan ang mga ilaw.#$b#May ipinapaalala ito sa akin mula pa noong napakatagal na panahon...$s

records.source: Well, the fish certainly smells fresh this season.
records.translation: Aba, talagang sariwa ang amoy ng isda ngayong panahon.

records.source: I like to check in with the local businesses and see how they're doing.
records.translation: Gusto kong kumustahin ang mga lokal na negosyo at tingnan kung maayos ang takbo nila.

records.source: I'm just here to make sure all of Marnie's business needs are met.
records.translation: Narito lang ako upang tiyaking natutugunan ang lahat ng pangangailangan ng negosyo ni Marnie.

records.source: I'm here to collect Clint's business tax.
records.translation: Narito ako upang kolektahin ang buwis sa negosyo ni Clint.

records.source: The library is one of Pelican Town's greatest features. It's funded with the taxes we collect from local business.
records.translation: Isa ang aklatan sa pinakamagagandang katangian ng Bayan ng Pelican. Pinopondohan ito ng mga buwis na kinokolekta namin mula sa mga lokal na negosyo.
